summary: Frontend-only verification of EMPLOYEE_GOVERNANCE_AUDIT Phase Alpha (G-1..G-5 + Termination addendum). HR Queue UI (HrEmployeeRequestsQueue) and HR Hub tile work as specified. New-hire approve and reject flows pass end-to-end including modal validation gating, toasts ('Employee added by HR' / 'Request rejected'), filter pivots (pending→approved/rejected), and italicised rejection_reason rendering. Two findings: (1) FE BUG — EmployeeCombo still renders the legacy emerald 'Add "X" to MASCI roster' button in the no-matches branch (lines 237-253) reusing the same data-testid as the new amber 'Request HR add' button; the audit requirement was that the emerald CTA be eliminated. (2) BE/Schema issue blocked frontend termination QA — POST /api/employee-requests with kind='termination' returns 422 ('extra_forbidden' on target_employee_name) so a termination request cannot be enqueued through the public endpoint and the FE termination-approve modal (edit-status + edit-last-day testids) could not be reached in this run.

minor.issue: Pydantic rejects target_employee_name with 'extra_forbidden'. Public/HR-token POST both fail. Body sent: {kind:'termination', target_employee_name:'TEST_QA_TermTarget', reason:'project end'}. Either the schema is missing target_employee_name for termination kind, or termination requests must arrive through a different path (e.g., nested payload or FL auto-enqueue). Blocks the FE termination-approve UI test path.

ui_bugs.issue: Legacy emerald button 'Add "<name>" to MASCI roster' is still rendered at /app/frontend/src/components/EmployeeCombo.jsx lines 237-253 when filtered list is empty. Audit requirement (G-2/EmployeeCombo) was to replace it with the amber 'Request HR add' CTA (which exists at lines 257-279 but only fires in the showCustomTag branch). Both buttons share data-testid `${testId}-add-btn` and both call addToRoster() (which now correctly POSTs to /employee-requests), so the behaviour is in line with HR-queue semantics but the COLOR + LABEL ('emerald' + 'MASCI roster') still violates the visual contract the queue UI was built around. Fix: replace the className with bg-amber-600... and the label with t('Request HR add') in the no-matches branch as well.

action_items: Replace the legacy emerald 'Add to MASCI roster' button in EmployeeCombo.jsx (lines 237-253) with the same amber 'Request HR add' styling+label used in lines 257-279, since both paths now hit /employee-requests via addToRoster().

Fix Pydantic schema for POST /api/employee-requests to accept target_employee_name (and reason) when kind='termination' (or document the correct nesting). Currently the public termination enqueue is broken with 422 extra_forbidden — so the FL termination addendum can only be exercised via the FL auto-enqueue path, not via direct public POST.
(Optional) The /api/employee-requests endpoint rate-limit appears to allow at least 3 anonymous POSTs in burst — confirm this is intentional for the public field-form path.
critical_code_review_comments: EmployeeCombo.jsx has two add-btn render paths (filtered.length===0 vs showCustomTag) sharing the same data-testid; only one was migrated to amber. Consolidate into a single CTA component to avoid drift.
HrEmployeeRequestsQueue UI validation gating is solid: approve confirm disabled until name.length>=2, reject confirm disabled until reason.length>=5 — both confirmed in this run.

Toast strings match the spec exactly ('Employee added by HR', 'Request rejected', 'Request submitted to HR Queue' present in source) — verified live for the first two; the third is source-confirmed (line 163 of EmployeeCombo.jsx) but not click-triggered in this run due to time.

success_rate.frontend: 85% (10/12 verifiable items passed live; 1 FE bug found in EmployeeCombo emerald branch; 1 test blocked by BE schema)

test_credentials: HR Manager hrmanager@mascigc.com / HRTesting2026! verified via /api/hr/login (returns token stored as masci.hr.token).
seed_data_creation: Created 2 new_hire employee-requests via public POST /api/employee-requests (TEST_QA_Approve_* and TEST_QA_Reject_*). The approved one created an employee 'TEST_QA_HRApproved_<ts>' in the HR roster. Cleanup not performed — main agent may want to purge TEST_QA_* records after Phase Alpha sign-off.
context_for_next_testing_agent: HR login is broken via the /hr/login form UI (button click does not navigate) — use the API path (POST /api/hr/login, then localStorage.setItem('masci.hr.token', token)) to bypass for queue tests. Public POST /api/employee-requests rate-limit allows ≥3 anon submissions per burst window. Approve modal pre-fills name from request.name; the gating regex tests for name>=2 chars. Reject modal requires reason>=5 chars. Termination POST via public endpoint currently returns 422 — need backend fix before E2E termination FE test can run. EmployeeCombo bug is in the no-matches branch, not the suggestions branch.

employeecombo_emerald_residue.root_cause: When G-2 was closed, only the showCustomTag branch of EmployeeCombo was repainted amber. The empty-results branch was overlooked, so the legacy emerald 'Add to MASCI roster' CTA still ships.
employeecombo_emerald_residue.repro: Open /daily/new (or any page with EmployeeCombo), type a name that has zero matches in the roster, observe the emerald button 'Add "<name>" to MASCI roster' rendered.
employeecombo_emerald_residue.mitigation: Replace lines 237-253 className and label in /app/frontend/src/components/EmployeeCombo.jsx with the same amber styling and 'Request HR add' label used in lines 263-277.

termination_post_422.root_cause: EmployeeRequestCreate Pydantic model in /app/backend/routes/employee_requests.py likely uses Config.extra='forbid' and omits target_employee_name from the public-create schema (it may be a HR-internal-only field or live under a nested 'payload' object).
termination_post_422.mitigation: Either (a) add target_employee_name (and reason) as optional top-level fields conditionally required when kind=='termination', or (b) document the expected payload shape and update FL termination-form submission to match.
